content.comment_body: When connecting KepServer6 with [product_name] [version_no], we encounter this error. Warning [company_name] TCP/IP Ethernet MY PROJECT.DAM SHUTTER | Unable to write to address on device. | Address = 'I0.1', Reason = 'Device returned data access error'. Error code = 0X5. How can this issue be resolved?
It's not possible to remotely write to a physical digital input.

analysis.insight_summary: Users trying to link KepServer6 with [product_name] [version_no] hardware face errors when attempting to write to physical digital input addresses. This shows a common misunderstanding about which device addresses are writable. The data access error can be confusing for those unfamiliar with limitations of hardware, affecting both usability and effective troubleshooting in the system.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to remotely write values to physical digital input addresses of [product_name] [version_no] using KepServer6 via [company_name] TCP/IP Ethernet.
